Canon - The Legend of the New Gods.name: Canon: Legend of the New Gods
Canon - The Legend of the New Gods.summary: Originally called Feng Shen Ying Jie Chuan, Canon - Legends of the New Gods is a strategy RPG originally for the Sega Genesis and Mega Drive consoles.

Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu - F1 Super Licen.name: Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu: F1 Super License
Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu - F1 Super Licen.summary:
Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu F1 Super License is a 1992 racing game by Varie for the Sega Mega Drive and the third Mega Drive game in their Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu games, following F1 Hero MD.

This game is a 2D racer, like F1 Grand Prix and unlike F1 Hero MD. B accelerates. This game adds a save system, allowing you to save your progress over the course of the prix.

Sonic 3.name: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
Sonic 3.summary: The game is a sequel to Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the same system and follows on directly from the end of the game, in which Sonic defeated his enemy, Dr. Robotnik; crash-landing on a floating island, Sonic encounters new character Knuckles the Echidna, and must once more retrieve the Chaos Emeralds while also working to stop Dr. Robotnik from relaunching his ship, the Death Egg.
